# Surface Labs

> Surface Labs is a node-based procedural PBR texture authoring tool for indie game developers. It is an independent, portable alternative to Substance 3D Designer.

Surface Labs builds complete PBR material sets (albedo, normal, roughness,
metallic, ambient occlusion and height) from a graph of GPU-evaluated nodes.
Every node runs as a fragment shader and the graph is the single source, so
changing an upstream input re-renders everything after it in real time, up to
4K.

## Facts

- Category: node-based procedural texture and PBR material authoring tool.
- Audience: indie game developers and technical artists.
- Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iPadOS, from a single (Flutter) codebase.
- Input: mouse, keyboard, touch, Apple Pencil and game controllers. Full
  game-controller navigation is built as an accessible alternative to mouse and
  touch.
- Works fully offline with no account, sign-in or telemetry.
- Node library includes Perlin, FBM, Voronoi and Cells noise, gradients, tile
  sampler; blur, sharpen, levels, curves, warp and gradient-map filters; blend
  and channel operations; normal-from-height, curvature and AO tools; histogram
  and math nodes. Custom nodes can be written in a built-in shading language.
- Export presets: Unreal Engine, Unity (URP and HDRP), Godot and glTF /
  three.js, with correct channel packing and DirectX or OpenGL normal
  orientation. Output as PNG, JPEG, TGA or BMP.
- Pricing: free during early access; $10 per platform planned at the 1.0.0
  release. One-time purchase, no subscription.
